description: This Java class 'SimpleAudioOutput' provides a basic implementation for audio output using Android's AudioTrack API. It includes methods to create, start, stop, and write audio data to an audio stream, primarily for experimentation or redirecting audio output in Android applications.

classes.name: SimpleAudioOutput
classes.description: A class for managing audio output streams using Android's AudioTrack API.

methods.name: SimpleAudioOutput
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the SimpleAudioOutput object.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates and starts the audio track with the specified frame rate.

methods.name: createAudioTrack
methods.description: Creates an AudioTrack object configured for stereo float PCM audio.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the AudioTrack buffer.
